evals.prompt: Generate a comprehensive 10-K analysis report for Medtronic (MDT)
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with all sections: executive summary, business overview, risk factors, financial highlights with 4-year revenue trend, MD&A summary, financial statements, valuation, analyst estimates, recent news, clinical trials, ESG, ownership, and appendices

assertions.name: report_generated
assertions.description: Report file is created and non-empty

assertions.name: has_executive_summary
assertions.description: Report contains executive summary section

assertions.name: has_revenue_trend_4_years
assertions.description: Report contains revenue trend table with at least 4 years of data

assertions.name: has_yoy_changes
assertions.description: Revenue table includes YoY percentage changes

assertions.name: has_risk_factors
assertions.description: Report contains risk factors section with table

assertions.name: has_mda_section
assertions.description: Report contains MD&A section

assertions.name: has_valuation_metrics
assertions.description: Report contains valuation metrics table

assertions.name: has_clinical_trials
assertions.description: Report includes clinical trials section for healthcare company

assertions.name: resolves_cik_correctly
assertions.description: Company resolution correctly identifies MDT as CIK 0001613103

evals.prompt: Create a 10-K report for Apple Inc. (AAPL)
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with technology company focus, segment breakdown (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables, Services), risk factors relevant to tech, financial trends, valuation metrics

assertions.name: report_generated
assertions.description: Report file is created for AAPL

assertions.name: has_segments
assertions.description: Report includes Apple's reportable segments

assertions.name: has_financial_highlights
assertions.description: Report contains financial highlights with revenue trend

assertions.name: no_clinical_trials
assertions.description: Non-healthcare company should not have clinical trials section or should note N/A

evals.expected_output: Comprehensive report for healthcare conglomerate with pharma, medtech, consumer segments, clinical pipeline, regulatory actions

assertions.name: report_generated
assertions.description: Report file is created for JNJ

assertions.name: has_three_segments
assertions.description: Report identifies JNJ's three main segments

assertions.name: has_clinical_data
assertions.description: Report includes clinical trials for pharma segment
